examples.chinese: A：謝謝你。 B：不客氣。
examples.pinyin: A: Xièxie nǐ. B: Bú kèqi.
examples.english: A: Thank you. B: You are welcome.

items.wordHook: 不(no) + 客(guest) + 氣(air) → 'no guest air' → don't be polite: 不客氣 says 'you're welcome'.

examples.chinese: 我喜歡聽音樂。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān tīng yīnyuè.
examples.english: I like to listen to music.

examples.chinese: 我要在家看書、聽音樂。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yào zài jiā kànshū, tīng yīnyuè.
examples.english: I am going to read and listen to music at home.

examples.chinese: 聽說這部電影很有趣，我們晚一起去看，好不好？
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō zhè bù diànyǐng hěn yǒuqù. Wǒmen wǎnshang yìqǐ qù kàn, hǎo bù hǎo?
examples.english: I heard that this movie is very interesting. How about we go to see it tonight?

examples.chinese: 可是我只想聽音樂、睡覺。
examples.pinyin: Kěshì wǒ zhǐ xiǎng tīng yīnyuè, shuìjiào.
examples.english: But I only want to listen to music and sleep.

examples.chinese: 聽說那家飯店不遠，我想我們可以從學校走路去。
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō nà jiā fàndiàn bù yuǎn, wǒ xiǎng wǒmen kěyǐ cóng xuéxiào zǒulù qù.
examples.english: I heard that the hotel is not far; I think we can go there from the school on foot.

examples.chinese: 聽說這個牌子的東西很貴，可是很多人喜歡。
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō zhè ge páizi de dōngxi hěn guì, kěshì hěn duō rén xǐhuān.
examples.english: I heard that this clothing brand is very expensive, but a lot of people like it.

examples.chinese: 對啊！聽說我們學校感冒、發燒的學生很多。
examples.pinyin: Duì a! Tīngshuō wǒmen xuéxiào gǎnmào, fāshāo de xuéshēng hěn duō.
examples.english: Right! I heard that many students from my school have a cold and fever.

examples.chinese: 我很擔心他，請他去看醫生，也告訴他要聽醫生的話，不要忘記多喝水、多休息。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hěn dānxīn tā, qǐng tā qù kàn yīshēng, yě gàosu tā yào tīng yīshēng de huà, bú yào wàngjì duō hē shuǐ, duō xiūxí.
examples.english: I’m so worried about him, so I told him to go see a doctor. I also told him to listen to the doctor, to drink plenty of water and get some rest.

items.wordHook: an 耳(ear) presses to a 一(one) line crossing a 十(ten) and a 罒(net), all 心(heart) → 聽(listen).

examples.chinese: 這個學期開始，從星期一到星期五我都有華語課，每天從上午八點四十分到中午十二點上課，下午一點寫功課，有時候也跟同學練習說中文。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge xuéqí kāishǐ, cóng xīngqí yī dào xīngqí wǔ, wǒ dōu yǒu Huáyǔ kè, měi tiān cóng shàngwǔ bā diǎn sìshí fēn dào zhōngwǔ shí’èr diǎn shàngkè, xiàwǔ yī diǎn xiě gōngkè, yǒushíhou yě gēn tóngxué liànxí shuō Zhōngwén.
examples.english: This semester I have Chinese class from 8:40 a.m. to 12:00 noon, Mondays to Fridays. I start to do my homework at 1:00 p.m., and sometimes I practice speaking Chinese with my classmates.

examples.chinese: 最近感冒的人很多，我的同學國安也感冒了，今天開始發燒了。
examples.pinyin: Zuìjìn gǎnmào de rén hěn duō, wǒ de tóngxué Guó'ān yě gǎnmào le, jīntiān kāishǐ fāshāo le.
examples.english: Many people got colds lately. My classmate, Guoan, got a cold, too. He started to have a fever today.

examples.chinese: 他寫的文章都很有趣，我很喜歡看。
examples.pinyin: Tā xiě de wénzhāng dōu hěn yǒuqù, wǒ hěn xǐhuan kàn.
examples.english: The articles he writes are all very interesting; I really like reading them.

examples.chinese: 我父親文章寫得很好，而且他的字也很漂亮。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ fùqīn wénzhāng xiě de hěn hǎo, érqiě tā de zì yě hěn piàoliang.
examples.english: My father writes articles very well, and moreover his handwriting is also very beautiful.

examples.chinese: 學校的網站上有很多學生寫的文章。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào de wǎngzhàn shàng yǒu hěn duō xuéshēng xiě de wénzhāng.
examples.english: On the school's website there are many articles written by students.

examples.chinese: 這篇文章的中文翻譯翻得很好。
examples.pinyin: Zhè piān wénzhāng de Zhōngwén fānyì fān de hěn hǎo.
examples.english: The Chinese translation of this article is translated very well.

examples.chinese: 歐先生有閱讀的障礙，就算一篇極短的文章，讀起來也覺得很困難。
examples.pinyin: Ōu xiānsheng yǒu yuèdú de zhàng'ài, jiùsuàn yī piān jí duǎn de wénzhāng, dú qǐlái yě juéde hěn kùnnán.
examples.english: Mr. Ou has a reading obstacle; even a very short article feels difficult for him to read.

examples.chinese: 那家報社非常細心，他們的文章從沒出現過一個錯字。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā bàoshè fēicháng xìxīn, tāmen de wénzhāng cóng méi chūxiànguò yí gè cuòzì.
examples.english: That newspaper publisher is very careful; their articles have never had a single typo.

items.wordHook: 文(writing) + 章(section) → a written section: 文章(an article; essay).

examples.chinese: 他的計畫是畢業以後到美國去工作。
examples.pinyin: Tā de jìhuà shì bìyè yǐhòu dào Měiguó qù gōngzuò.
examples.english: His plan is to go to the United States to work after graduation.

examples.chinese: 我計畫暑假跟朋友到南部去走走。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jìhuà shǔjià gēn péngyǒu dào nánbù qù zǒuzou.
examples.english: I plan to go to the south with friends to walk around during summer vacation.

examples.chinese: 新年是一個新的開始，所以每年一開始就要做好計畫。
examples.pinyin: Xīnnián shì yī gè xīn de kāishǐ, suǒyǐ měi nián yī kāishǐ jiù yào zuò hǎo jìhuà.
examples.english: The New Year is a new beginning, so at the beginning of every year, you should make a good plan.

examples.chinese: 我家的狗很乖，從不破壞家裡的東西。颱風快來了，破壞了我本來要去露營的計畫。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiā de gǒu hěn guāi, cóng bù pòhuài jiālǐ de dōngxī. Táifēng kuài lái le, pòhuài le wǒ běnlái yào qù lùyíng de jìhuà.
examples.english: Our dog is very well-behaved and never destroys things in the house. The typhoon is coming soon, and it destroyed my original plan to go camping.

examples.chinese: 這個星期經理一連寫了三個推銷新產品的計畫，每天都忙得不得了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xīngqī jīnglǐ yīlián xiě le sān gè tuīxiāo xīn chǎnpǐn de jìhuà, měi tiān dōu máng de bùdéliǎo.
examples.english: This week the manager wrote three plans for promoting new products in succession; he is extremely busy every day.

examples.chinese: 每年冬天快到時，舅舅和舅媽就開始計畫去滑雪，有時還約我跟媽媽一起去。
examples.pinyin: Měi nián dōngtiān kuài dào shí, jiùjiu hé jiùmā jiù kāishǐ jìhuà qù huáxuě, yǒushí hái yuē wǒ gēn māma yīqǐ qù.
examples.english: Every year when winter is approaching, my uncle and aunt start planning to go skiing, and sometimes they even invite me and my mom to go together.

examples.chinese: 現在突然下起了大雨，我們的計畫被破壞了，恐怕今天所有的活動都必須重新安排。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài tūrán xià qǐ le dàyǔ, wǒmen de jìhuà bèi pòhuài le, kǒngpà jīntiān suǒyǒu de huódòng dōu bìxū chóngxīn ānpái.
examples.english: Now it has suddenly started raining heavily, and our plans have been ruined; I'm afraid all of today's activities must be rearranged anew.

examples.chinese: A:聽說明天的會跟新商品的推銷計畫有關，你要參加嗎？ B:我是公司的安全人員，這個會應該跟我無關。
examples.pinyin: A: Tīngshuō míngtiān de huì gēn xīn shāngpǐn de tuīxiāo jìhuà yǒuguān, nǐ yào cānjiā ma? B: Wǒ shì gōngsī de ānquán rényuán, zhège huì yīnggāi gēn wǒ wúguān.
examples.english: A: I heard that tomorrow's meeting is related to the new product promotion plan; are you going to attend? B: I am the company's security personnel; this meeting should be unrelated to me.

examples.chinese: 這次的露營活動因為颱風辦不成了，可以說計畫永遠沒辦法趕上變化。張老闆開會開得太久，沒趕上飛機，只好花錢再買一張機票了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì de lùyíng huódòng yīnwèi táifēng bàn bù chéng le, kěyǐ shuō jìhuà yǒngyuǎn méi bànfǎ gǎnshàng biànhuà. Zhāng lǎobǎn kāihuì kāi de tài jiǔ, méi gǎnshàng fēijī, zhǐhǎo huā qián zài mǎi yī zhāng jīpiào le.
examples.english: This camping activity couldn't be held because of the typhoon; you could say that plans can never catch up with changes. Boss Zhang's meeting went on too long, and he didn't catch the plane, so he had no choice but to spend money to buy another ticket.

examples.chinese: 我的法國朋友最初只計畫來臺灣學中文，沒想到後來拿到了獎學金，還念了博士班。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de Fǎguó péngyǒu zuìchū zhǐ jìhuà lái Táiwān xué Zhōngwén, méi xiǎngdào hòulái nádàole jiǎngxuéjīn, hái niànle bóshìbān.
examples.english: At first, my French friend only planned to come to Taiwan to study Chinese; unexpectedly, later he received a scholarship and even studied in a doctoral program.

examples.chinese: 這個改善空氣品質的計畫，已經實行三年了，還需要一段時間才能看到成果。
examples.pinyin: Zhège gǎishàn kōngqì pǐnzhí de jìhuà, yǐjīng shíxíng sān nián le, hái xūyào yī duàn shíjiān cái néng kàndào chéngguǒ.
examples.english: This plan to improve air quality has already been carried out for three years; it still needs some time before results can be seen.

examples.chinese: 這個銷售計畫很好，不過得先解決相關費用和推銷人員等現實問題。A:如果現在有一千萬從天上掉下來，那該多好啊！ B:你別再做夢了，趕快回到現實吧！
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiāoshòu jìhuà hěn hǎo, bùguò děi xiān jiějué xiāngguān fèiyòng hé tuīxiāo rényuán děng xiànshí wèntí. A: Rúguǒ xiànzài yǒu yīqiān wàn cóng tiānshàng diào xiàlái, nà gāi duō hǎo a! B: Nǐ bié zài zuòmèng le, gǎnkuài huídào xiànshí ba!
examples.english: This sales plan is good, but we must first solve realistic problems such as related costs and sales personnel. A: If ten million were to fall from the sky right now, how great that would be! B: Stop dreaming and quickly return to reality!

examples.chinese: 古小姐做事的態度很積極，為了完成任務，總是很早就做好計畫，而且立刻實行。
examples.pinyin: Gǔ xiǎojiě zuòshì de tàidù hěn jījí, wèile wánchéng rènwù, zǒngshì hěn zǎo jiù zuò hǎo jìhuà, érqiě lìkè shíxíng.
examples.english: Miss Gu has a very proactive attitude toward work. In order to complete tasks, she always makes plans early and immediately carries them out.

examples.chinese: 為了使市區（shìqū， urban area）的交通更便利，目前黃市長正進行各種改善計畫。
examples.pinyin: Wèile shǐ shìqū de jiāotōng gèng biànlì, mùqián Huáng shìzhǎng zhèng jìnxíng gè zhǒng gǎishàn jìhuà.
examples.english: In order to make traffic in the urban area more convenient, right now Mayor Huang is proceeding with various improvement plans.

examples.chinese: 這幾年由於市長積極實行交通建設計畫，使當地交通情況明顯改善了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jǐ nián yóuyú shìzhǎng jījí shíxíng jiāotōng jiànshè jìhuà, shǐ dāngdì jiāotōng qíngkuàng míngxiǎn gǎishàn le.
examples.english: In recent years, because the mayor actively implemented a transportation construction plan, the local traffic situation has obviously improved.

examples.chinese: 教授打算向學校申請一筆經費，進行高山地區的調查計畫。
examples.pinyin: Jiàoshòu dǎsuàn xiàng xuéxiào shēnqǐng yī bǐ jīngfèi, jìnxíng gāoshān dìqū de diàochá jìhuà.
examples.english: The professor plans to apply to the school for a sum of funding to carry out a survey project in the high mountain areas.

examples.chinese: 你的商品計畫，我可以幫你一起做，反正我晚上沒事。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ de shāngpǐn jìhuà, wǒ kěyǐ bāng nǐ yìqǐ zuò, fǎnzhèng wǒ wǎnshang méi shì.
examples.english: I can help you work on your product plan together; anyway, I have nothing to do tonight.

examples.chinese: 經理對新產品計畫的指示不太清楚，我們最好去問清楚。
examples.pinyin: Jīnglǐ duì xīn chǎnpǐn jìhuà de zhǐshì bù tài qīngchu, wǒmen zuì hǎo qù wèn qīngchu.
examples.english: The manager's instructions about the new product plan are not very clear; we'd better go ask and clarify.

examples.chinese: 哎喲，已經半夜一點多了！我們就別再加班寫產品計畫了，等明天再繼續吧！
examples.pinyin: Āiyō, yǐjīng bànyè yìdiǎn duō le! Wǒmen jiù bié zài jiābān xiě chǎnpǐn jìhuà le, děng míngtiān zài jìxù ba!
examples.english: Woah, it's already past one in the morning! Let's stop working overtime to write the product plan, and continue tomorrow!

examples.chinese: 申請留學的過程中，最讓人操心的可能就是寫讀書計畫了。
examples.pinyin: Shēnqǐng liúxué de guòchéng zhōng, zuì ràng rén cāoxīn de kěnéng jiù shì xiě dúshū jìhuà le.
examples.english: In the process of applying to study abroad, what worries people the most is probably writing the study plan.

examples.chinese: A:幸虧有你的建議，投資計畫才有很好的結果，真是多謝你了？ B:哪裡哪裡，都是你自己努力得到的成果，要謝就謝你自己吧！
examples.pinyin: A: Xìngkuī yǒu nǐ de jiànyì, tóuzī jìhuà cái yǒu hěn hǎo de jiéguǒ, zhēn shì duōxiè nǐ le? B: Nǎlǐ nǎlǐ, dōu shì nǐ zìjǐ nǔlì dédào de chéngguǒ, yào xiè jiù xiè nǐ zìjǐ ba!
examples.english: A: Thanks to your suggestion, the investment plan got a very good result; thank you so much! B: Not at all, it's all the result of your own hard work; if you want to thank anyone, thank yourself!

examples.chinese: 他正在修改明天要交出去的計畫，你別去打擾他。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhèngzài xiūgǎi míngtiān yào jiāo chūqù de jìhuà, nǐ bié qù dǎrǎo tā.
examples.english: He is revising the plan that is due tomorrow; don't go disturb him.

examples.chinese: 一項計畫假如目標不明確，往往就得不到想要的結果。
examples.pinyin: Yí xiàng jìhuà jiǎrú mùbiāo bù míngquè, wǎngwǎng jiù dé bú dào xiǎngyào de jiéguǒ.
examples.english: If a plan's goals are not clear-cut, it often fails to achieve the desired results.

examples.chinese: 他的計畫使公司賠了一大筆錢，因此他以辭職表示負責。
examples.pinyin: Tā de jìhuà shǐ gōngsī péi le yī dà bǐ qián, yīncǐ tā yǐ cízhí biǎoshì fùzé.
examples.english: His plan caused the company to lose a large sum of money, so he resigned to show responsibility.

examples.chinese: 他對亞洲文化相當有興趣，計畫將來走遍全亞洲。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì Yàzhōu wénhuà xiāngdāng yǒu xìngqù, jìhuà jiānglái zǒu biàn quán Yàzhōu.
examples.english: He is quite interested in Asian culture and plans to travel all over Asia in the future.

examples.chinese: 祕書趁老闆不在把商品計畫偷走，這事已經交給法院處理了。
examples.pinyin: Mìshū chèn lǎobǎn bú zài bǎ shāngpǐn jìhuà tōu zǒu, zhè shì yǐjīng jiāo gěi fǎyuàn chǔlǐ le.
examples.english: The secretary took advantage of the boss's absence to steal the product plan; this matter has already been handed over to the court.

examples.chinese: 這項研究計畫只針對少部分區域實驗，參考價值不高。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiàng yánjiū jìhuà zhǐ zhēnduì shǎo bùfèn qūyù shíyàn, cānkǎo jiàzhí bù gāo.
examples.english: This research project only conducts experiments in a small number of areas, so its reference value is not high.

examples.chinese: 解決環境受汙染的問題需要長久的計畫。
examples.pinyin: Jiějué huánjìng shòu wūrǎn de wèntí xūyào chángjiǔ de jìhuà.
examples.english: Solving the problem of environmental pollution requires a long-term plan.

items.wordHook: 計畫 means plan: calculate (計) and draw (畫) the steps.

examples.chinese: 我每天早上七點去學校運動。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měi tiān zǎoshang qī diǎn qù xuéxiào yùndòng.
examples.english: I go to school to exercise at 7:00 every morning.

examples.chinese: 我今天晚上要去同學家玩。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jīntiān wǎnshang yào qù tóngxué jiā wán.
examples.english: I am going to hang out with my classmate at his/her place tonight.

examples.chinese: 這個學期開始，從星期一到星期五我都有華語課，每天從上午八點四十分到中午十二點上課，下午一點寫功課，有時候也跟同學練習說中文。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge xuéqí kāishǐ, cóng xīngqí yī dào xīngqí wǔ, wǒ dōu yǒu Huáyǔ kè, měi tiān cóng shàngwǔ bā diǎn sìshí fēn dào zhōngwǔ shí’èr diǎn shàngkè, xiàwǔ yī diǎn xiě gōngkè, yǒushíhou yě gēn tóngxué liànxí shuō Zhōngwén.
examples.english: This semester I have Chinese class from 8:40 a.m. to 12:00 noon, Mondays to Fridays. I start to do my homework at 1:00 p.m., and sometimes I practice speaking Chinese with my classmates.

items.wordHook: 上(on top) + 學(learn): you go up to learn → to go to school.

examples.chinese: A：謝謝你。 B：不客氣。
examples.pinyin: A: Xièxie nǐ. B: Bú kèqi.
examples.english: A: Thank you. B: You are welcome.

examples.chinese: 今天下午學校有籃球比賽，我們去看吧！
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān xiàwǔ xuéxiào yǒu lánqiú bǐsài, wǒmen qù kàn ba!
examples.english: There is a basketball game at school this afternoon. Let’s go watch it!

examples.chinese: 前天下午我在學校的圖書館看書。
examples.pinyin: Qiántiān xiàwǔ wǒ zài xuéxiào de túshūguǎn kànshū.
examples.english: I read at the school library in the afternoon of the day before yesterday.

examples.chinese: 我跟媽媽明天下午要一起去看電影。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēn māma míngtiān xiàwǔ yào yìqǐ qù kàn diànyǐng.
examples.english: Mom and I are going to see a movie tomorrow afternoon.

examples.chinese: 你的錢包在那件衣服下面。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ de qiánbāo zài nà jiàn yīfu xiàmiàn.
examples.english: Your wallet is under that piece of clothing.

examples.chinese: 我週末還要工作，打算一下班就去看燈會。我們可以約友美一起去。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhōumò hái yào gōngzuò, dǎsuàn yí xiàbān jiù qù kàn dēnghuì. Wǒmen kěyǐ yuē Yǒuměi yìqǐ qù.
examples.english: I have to work on weekends, and plan to go to the Lantern Carnival as soon as I get off from work. We can ask Youmei out for the Lantern Carnival together.

examples.chinese: 我們下個星期要學第十五課，我剛才先看了一點兒，書上有很多種動物，我覺得很有意思。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xià ge xīngqí yào xué dì shíwǔ kè, wǒ gāngcái xiān kàn le yìdiǎnr, shū shàng yǒu hěn duō zhǒng dòngwù, wǒ juéde hěn yǒuyìsi.
examples.english: We are going to learn lesson fifteen next week. I previewed a bit earlier just now. There are many kinds of animals in the book; I think it is very interesting.

examples.chinese: 這個學期開始，從星期一到星期五我都有華語課，每天從上午八點四十分到中午十二點上課，下午一點寫功課，有時候也跟同學練習說中文。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge xuéqí kāishǐ, cóng xīngqí yī dào xīngqí wǔ, wǒ dōu yǒu Huáyǔ kè, měi tiān cóng shàngwǔ bā diǎn sìshí fēn dào zhōngwǔ shí’èr diǎn shàngkè, xiàwǔ yī diǎn xiě gōngkè, yǒushíhou yě gēn tóngxué liànxí shuō Zhōngwén.
examples.english: This semester I have Chinese class from 8:40 a.m. to 12:00 noon, Mondays to Fridays. I start to do my homework at 1:00 p.m., and sometimes I practice speaking Chinese with my classmates.

examples.chinese: 下個星期華語課有期中考，我有一點兒緊張，所以每天晚上都讀書，也練習寫字，希望下個星期的考試能考得很好。
examples.pinyin: Xià ge xīngqí Huáyǔ kè yǒu qízhōngkǎo, wǒ yǒu yìdiǎnr jǐnzhāng, suǒyǐ měi tiān wǎnshang dōu dúshū, yě liànxí xiězì, xīwàng xià ge xīngqí de kǎoshì néng kǎo de hěn hǎo.
examples.english: I will have the midterm exam for Chinese class next week. I am a bit nervous so I study every night and practice writing Chinese characters as well. I hope I can do well on the exam next week.

examples.chinese: 我們班只能禮拜一跟禮拜二下午用。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen bān zhǐ néng lǐbài yī gēn lǐbài èr xiàwǔ yòng.
examples.english: Our class can only use it in the afternoon on Mondays and Tuesdays.

examples.chinese: 沒關係，我們可以下個週末再來看。對了，妳要買鞋子吧？
examples.pinyin: Méiguānxi, wǒmen kěyǐ xià ge zhōumò zài lái kàn. Duìle, nǐ yào mǎi xiézi ba?
examples.english: It’s okay; we can come again next weekend. By the way, you want to buy shoes, don’t you?

examples.chinese: 鞋子都在一樓，我們到樓下去吧！九點了，百貨公司快要關了。
examples.pinyin: Xiézi dōu zài yì lóu, wǒmen dào lóuxià qù ba! Jiǔ diǎn le, bǎihuògōngsī kuàiyào guān le.
examples.english: All the shoes are on the first floor. Let’s go downstairs. It’s 9:00; the department store is closing soon.

examples.chinese: 我們下午四點要到天美飯店，她在那裡等我們。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xiàwǔ sì diǎn yào dào Tiānměi Fàndiàn, tā zài nàli děng wǒmen.
examples.english: We have to arrive at Tianmei Hotel at 4 in the afternoon. She will wait for us there.

examples.chinese: 媽，我跟友美要去喝下午茶，可是我的錢包不在房間裡。
examples.pinyin: Mā, wǒ gēn Yǒuměi yào qù hē xiàwǔ chá, kěshì wǒ de qiánbāo bú zài fángjiān lǐ.
examples.english: Mom, Youmei and I are going to have afternoon tea now, but my wallet is not in the bedroom.

examples.chinese: 沙發下面呢？
examples.pinyin: Shāfā xiàmiàn ne?
examples.english: How about checking under the sofa?

examples.chinese: 沙發上面、下面跟旁邊都沒有。媽，妳幫我找，好嗎？
examples.pinyin: Shāfā shàngmiàn, xiàmiàn gēn pángbiān dōu méiyǒu. Mā, nǐ bāng wǒ zhǎo, hǎo ma?
examples.english: It is neither on the sofa, under the sofa, nor beside the sofa. Mom, could you find it for me?

examples.chinese: 啊！在這裡！錢包在我的書下面。
examples.pinyin: A! Zài zhèlǐ! Qiánbāo zài wǒ de shū xiàmiàn.
examples.english: Ah! There it is! The wallet is under my book.

examples.chinese: 妳星期六下午有空嗎？我們一起去喝下午茶，怎麼樣？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xīngqí liù xiàwǔ yǒukòng ma? Wǒmen yìqǐ qù hē xiàwǔ chá, zěnmeyàng?
examples.english: Are you available on Saturday afternoon? How about we have afternoon tea together?

examples.chinese: 我們這個星期六下午兩點半去吧。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zhè ge xīngqí liù xiàwǔ liǎng diǎn bàn qù ba.
examples.english: Let’s go this Saturday at 2:30 p.m.

examples.chinese: 我下午有課，中午不回家。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiàwǔ yǒu kè, zhōngwǔ bù huí jiā.
examples.english: I have class in the afternoon; I am not coming home at noon.

examples.chinese: 你幾點下課？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ jǐ diǎn xiàkè?
examples.english: What time do you get out of class?

examples.chinese: 我四點四十分下課。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ sì diǎn sìshí fēn xiàkè.
examples.english: I get out of class at 4:40.

examples.chinese: 你唱的這首歌真好聽，可以請你再唱一遍嗎？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ chàng de zhè shǒu gē zhēn hǎotīng, kěyǐ qǐng nǐ zài chàng yī biàn ma?
examples.english: This song you sang is really nice; could I ask you to sing it one more time?

examples.chinese: 我每次寫完考卷都會仔細檢查一遍，要是發現錯誤就馬上改過來。費太太結婚後才發現這是個錯誤決定，她不知道該怎麼辦才好。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měi cì xiě wán kǎojuàn dōu huì zǐxì jiǎnchá yí biàn, yàoshi fāxiàn cuòwù jiù mǎshàng gǎi guòlái. Fèi tàitai jiéhūn hòu cái fāxiàn zhè shì ge cuòwù juédìng, tā bù zhīdào gāi zěnme bàn cái hǎo.
examples.english: Every time I finish writing an exam paper, I carefully check it once; if I find a mistake, I immediately correct it. Mrs. Fei only discovered after marriage that this was a wrong decision, and she doesn't know what to do.

examples.chinese: 夏天時，在臺灣、日本、菲律賓都有颱風，這是很普遍的現象。
examples.pinyin: Xiàtiān shí, zài Táiwān, Rìběn, Fēilǜbīn dōu yǒu táifēng, zhè shì hěn pǔbiàn de xiànxiàng.
examples.english: In summer, there are typhoons in Taiwan, Japan, and the Philippines; this is a very common phenomenon.

examples.chinese: 上課光聽老師教是沒用的，還要親自練習幾遍。
examples.pinyin: Shàngkè guāng tīng lǎoshī jiāo shì méiyòng de, hái yào qīnzì liànxí jǐ biàn.
examples.english: In class, merely listening to the teacher teach is useless; you also need to practice it yourself several times.

examples.chinese: 雖然現在網路很普遍了，還是有不少人喜歡聽電臺的節目。
examples.pinyin: Suīrán xiànzài wǎnglù hěn pǔbiàn le, hái shì yǒu bùshǎo rén xǐhuān tīng diàntái de jiémù.
examples.english: Although the internet is very common now, there are still quite a few people who like to listen to radio station programs.

examples.chinese: 他對亞洲文化相當有興趣，計畫將來走遍全亞洲。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì Yàzhōu wénhuà xiāngdāng yǒu xìngqù, jìhuà jiānglái zǒu biàn quán Yàzhōu.
examples.english: He is quite interested in Asian culture and plans to travel all over Asia in the future.

items.wordHook: Through tireless 辶(movement) across town, posting signs upon each wooden 扁(board) all around → 遍(everywhere).

examples.chinese: 中國功夫是一種運動，也是一種藝術。
examples.pinyin: Zhōngguó gōngfu shì yī zhǒng yùndòng, yě shì yī zhǒng yìshù.
examples.english: Chinese kung fu is a kind of sport and also a kind of art.

examples.chinese: 今天藝術系的學生要在學校的禮堂，演出跟十二生肖有關的故事。 那名演員很厲害，在那部電影裡一個人演出三個角色。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān yìshù xì de xuéshēng yào zài xuéxiào de lǐtáng, yǎnchū gēn shí'èr shēngxiào yǒuguān de gùshì. Nà míng yǎnyuán hěn lìhài, zài nà bù diànyǐng lǐ yīgè rén yǎnchū sān gè juésè.
examples.english: Today the art department students are going to perform a story related to the twelve zodiac signs in the school auditorium. That actor is very impressive; in that movie, he performed three roles by himself.

examples.chinese: 為了配合藝術課程的內容，黃老師帶領學生去參觀博物館和美術館。
examples.pinyin: Wèile pèihé yìshù kèchéng de nèiróng, Huáng lǎoshī dàilǐng xuésheng qù cānguān bówùguǎn hé měishùguǎn.
examples.english: In order to fit the content of the art course, Teacher Huang led the students to visit the museum and the art gallery.

examples.chinese: 康先生把這塊木頭刻成了一隻鳥，這個藝術作品完成後，還能放在美術館呢！
examples.pinyin: Kāng xiānsheng bǎ zhè kuài mùtou kè chéng le yī zhī niǎo, zhège yìshù zuòpǐn wánchéng hòu, hái néng fàng zài měishùguǎn ne!
examples.english: Mr. Kang carved this piece of wood into a bird; after this artwork is finished, it can even be placed in an art museum!

examples.chinese: 不少博物館裡的藝術品都是從古代保留到現代的，具有重要的時代意義。
examples.pinyin: Bùshǎo bówùguǎn lǐ de yìshùpǐn dōu shì cóng gǔdài bǎoliú dào xiàndài de, jùyǒu zhòngyào de shídài yìyì.
examples.english: Many artworks in museums have been preserved from ancient times to the present and have important historical significance.

examples.chinese: 為了提高這座城市的文化水準，市長積極建設藝術表演中心、圖書館等公共空間。像機場、高鐵、捷運這類公共交通建設，都需要很多經費才能完成。
examples.pinyin: Wèile tígāo zhè zuò chéngshì de wénhuà shuǐzhǔn, shìzhǎng jījí jiànshè yìshù biǎoyǎn zhōngxīn, túshūguǎn děng gōnggòng kōngjiān. Xiàng jīchǎng, gāotiě, jiéyùn zhè lèi gōnggòng jiāotōng jiànshè, dōu xūyào hěn duō jīngfèi cái néng wánchéng.
examples.english: In order to raise the cultural level of this city, the mayor actively builds public spaces such as art performance centers and libraries. Public transportation construction such as airports, high-speed rail, and MRT requires a lot of funds to complete.

examples.chinese: 博物館內的藝術品價值都很高，不小心弄壞了可是要賠償不少錢的。
examples.pinyin: Bówùguǎn nèi de yìshùpǐn jiàzhí dōu hěn gāo, bù xiǎoxīn nòng huài le kěshì yào péicháng bù shǎo qián de.
examples.english: The artworks in the museum are all very valuable; if you accidentally damage them, you will have to compensate a lot of money.

examples.chinese: 媽媽買了鮮花來插花，她覺得插花是一門藝術，讓人欣賞到花的美。
examples.pinyin: Māma mǎi le xiānhuā lái chāhuā, tā juéde chāhuā shì yī mén yìshù, ràng rén xīnshǎng dào huā de měi.
examples.english: Mom bought fresh flowers to do flower arranging; she feels that flower arranging is an art that lets people appreciate the beauty of flowers.

examples.chinese: 對科學家或藝術家來說，提供他們一個不受限制的工作環境是很重要的。
examples.pinyin: Duì kēxuéjiā huò yìshùjiā lái shuō, tígōng tāmen yī gè bù shòu xiànzhì de gōngzuò huánjìng shì hěn zhòngyào de.
examples.english: For scientists or artists, providing them with a work environment that is not restricted is very important.

examples.chinese: [{"chinese":"同事都走了，只剩下他一個人還在做事。","pinyin":"","english":""},{"chinese":"他是廣告公司的經理，每天要做好多事，忙得不得了。","pinyin":"","english":""}]
examples.pinyin: Tóngshì dōu zǒu le, zhǐ shèngxià tā yí ge rén hái zài zuòshì. Tā shì guǎnggào gōngsī de jīnglǐ, měitiān yào zuò hǎo duō shì, máng de bùdéliǎo.
examples.english: The colleagues have all left; only he is left still working. He is a manager at an advertising company; every day he has to do a lot of work and is incredibly busy.

examples.chinese: 父母應該好好地教育孩子，讓他們明白做人、做事的道理。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ yīnggāi hǎohǎo de jiàoyù háizi, ràng tāmen míngbai zuòrén, zuòshì de dàolǐ.
examples.english: Parents should educate their children well, so that they understand the principles of conducting oneself and doing things.

examples.chinese: 那位大明星身上穿的、手上戴的 ，都是有名的牌子。經理做事態度認真、負責，我從他身上學到了很多做人做事的道理。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi dà míngxīng shēnshang chuān de, shǒushang dài de, dōu shì yǒumíng de páizi. Jīnglǐ zuòshì tàidù rènzhēn, fùzé, wǒ cóng tā shēnshang xué dào le hěn duō zuòrén zuòshì de dàolǐ.
examples.english: What that big star wears on her body and on her hands are all famous brands. The manager's work attitude is serious and responsible; I have learned many principles of how to conduct myself and do things from him.

examples.chinese: 父母做人做事的態度，對孩子會產生極大的影響。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ zuòrén zuòshì de tàidù, duì háizi huì chǎnshēng jí dà de yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english: Parents' attitudes toward how they conduct themselves and handle matters will produce a tremendous influence on their children.

examples.chinese: 就我對小林的了解，他是一個很實在的人，不但做事認真，說話也不誇張。
examples.pinyin: Jiù wǒ duì Xiǎo Lín de liǎojiě, tā shì yīgè hěn shízài de rén, bùdàn zuòshì rènzhēn, shuōhuà yě bù kuāzhāng.
examples.english: With regard to my understanding of Xiao Lin, he is a very honest person; not only does he work seriously, but he also doesn't exaggerate when he speaks.

examples.chinese: 他畢竟是個小孩子，還不懂做人做事的道理，等他長大就會明白了。
examples.pinyin: Tā bìjìng shì ge xiǎoháizi, hái bù dǒng zuòrén zuòshì de dàolǐ, děng tā zhǎngdà jiù huì míngbai le.
examples.english: After all, he is a child and doesn't yet understand the principles of how to conduct himself and do things; when he grows up, he will understand.

examples.chinese: 他做事的態度很差，而且一不高興就罵人，誰受得了這種人啊！
examples.pinyin: Tā zuòshì de tàidù hěn chà, érqiě yí bù gāoxìng jiù mà rén, shéi shòu de liǎo zhè zhǒng rén a!
examples.english: His attitude toward work is very bad, and whenever he is unhappy he scolds people; who can tolerate this kind of person!

examples.chinese: 父母除了教導孩子做人做事的道理，也應該肯定他們的表現，讓他們更有自信。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ chúle jiàodǎo háizi zuòrén zuòshì de dàolǐ, yě yīnggāi kěndìng tāmen de biǎoxiàn, ràng tāmen gèng yǒu zìxìn.
examples.english: Besides teaching children the principles of how to conduct themselves and do things, parents should also affirm their performance so that they have more confidence.

examples.chinese: 小馬做事又負責又認真，答應別人的事情也一定會做到，是個很可靠的人。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Mǎ zuòshì yòu fùzé yòu rènzhēn, dāying biérén de shìqíng yě yīdìng huì zuòdào, shì gè hěn kěkào de rén.
examples.english: Xiao Ma is both responsible and serious in doing things, and he will definitely do what he promises others; he is a very reliable person.

examples.chinese: 父母是孩子的榜樣，他們的性格和做人做事的態度，對孩子都有很大的影響。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ shì háizi de bǎngyàng, tāmen de xìnggé hé zuòrén zuòshì de tàidù, duì háizi dōu yǒu hěn dà de yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english: Parents are their children's role models; their personality and their attitude toward how to conduct themselves and do things both have a great influence on their children.

examples.chinese: 許經理有兩點值得我們學習，第一點是做事仔細，第二點是有耐心。你的白襯衫上面有一個黑點，快脫下來，我幫你洗一洗。
examples.pinyin: Xǔ jīnglǐ yǒu liǎng diǎn zhídé wǒmen xuéxí, dì yī diǎn shì zuòshì zǐxì, dì èr diǎn shì yǒu nàixīn. Nǐ de bái chènshān shàngmiàn yǒu yī gè hēi diǎn, kuài tuō xiàlái, wǒ bāng nǐ xǐ yī xǐ.
examples.english: Manager Xu has two points worth learning from: the first point is that he is careful in his work, and the second point is that he is patient. There is a black spot on your white shirt; quickly take it off, and I'll help you wash it.

examples.chinese: 史小姐做事很細心，這張表我檢查過好幾次，還是被她發現了幾個錯字。
examples.pinyin: Shǐ xiǎojiě zuòshì hěn xìxīn, zhè zhāng biǎo wǒ jiǎnchá guo hǎojǐ cì, háishi bèi tā fāxiàn le jǐ ge cuòzì.
examples.english: Ms. Shi is very careful in her work; I checked this form several times, but she still found a few typos.

examples.chinese: 顏小姐的職場表現很優秀，除了外文能力好，做事也很細心。
examples.pinyin: Yán xiǎojiě de zhíchǎng biǎoxiàn hěn yōuxiù, chúle wàiwén nénglì hǎo, zuòshì yě hěn xìxīn.
examples.english: Ms. Yan's performance in the workplace is outstanding; besides having good foreign language skills, she is also very careful in her work.

examples.chinese: 爸爸常教導我做人要謙虛，太驕傲的話，不僅讓人討厭，做事也可能不順利。
examples.pinyin: Bàba cháng jiàodǎo wǒ zuòrén yào qiānxū, tài jiāo'ào de huà, bùjǐn ràng rén tǎoyàn, zuòshì yě kěnéng bù shùnlì.
examples.english: Dad often teaches me to be modest. If you are too arrogant, not only will people dislike you, but things may not go smoothly either.

examples.chinese: 古小姐做事的態度很積極，為了完成任務，總是很早就做好計畫，而且立刻實行。
examples.pinyin: Gǔ xiǎojiě zuòshì de tàidù hěn jījí, wèile wánchéng rènwù, zǒngshì hěn zǎo jiù zuò hǎo jìhuà, érqiě lìkè shíxíng.
examples.english: Miss Gu has a very proactive attitude toward work. In order to complete tasks, she always makes plans early and immediately carries them out.

examples.chinese: A:我到底該怎麼做才能讓老闆滿意？ B:你太驕傲、個性太急， 做事也不夠仔細。總之， 先把自己的缺點改掉吧。
examples.pinyin: A: Wǒ dàodǐ gāi zěnme zuò cái néng ràng lǎobǎn mǎnyì? B: Nǐ tài jiāo'ào, gèxìng tài jí, zuòshì yě bù gòu zǐxì. Zǒngzhī, xiān bǎ zìjǐ de quēdiǎn gǎi diào ba.
examples.english: A: What on earth should I do to satisfy the boss? B: You are too arrogant, your personality is too impatient, and you are not careful enough in doing things. In short, first change your shortcomings.

examples.chinese: 小王做事非常粗心，因此公司一直不敢把重要的業務交給他。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Wáng zuòshì fēicháng cūxīn, yīncǐ gōngsī yīzhí bù gǎn bǎ zhòngyào de yèwù jiāo gěi tā.
examples.english: Xiao Wang is very careless in doing things, so the company has never dared to hand important business over to him.

examples.chinese: 他做事很慢，時常要人催他。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuòshì hěn màn, shícháng yào rén cuī tā.
examples.english: He does things very slowly; he often needs people to press him.

examples.chinese: 他個性獨立，加上做事總是很細心，因此老闆很欣賞他。
examples.pinyin: Tā gèxìng dúlì, jiāshàng zuòshì zǒngshì hěn xìxīn, yīncǐ lǎobǎn hěn xīnshǎng tā.
examples.english: He has an independent personality; on top of that, he is always very careful in doing things, so the boss appreciates him very much.

examples.chinese: 除非別人願意，否則你不該強迫其他人全按你的意見做事。
examples.pinyin: Chúfēi biérén yuànyì, fǒuzé nǐ bù gāi qiángpò qítā rén quán àn nǐ de yìjiàn zuòshì.
examples.english: Unless others are willing, otherwise you should not force other people to do everything according to your opinion.

examples.chinese: 我爸爸認為我們這一代做事不夠積極，缺少耐心。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bàba rènwéi wǒmen zhè yī dài zuòshì bù gòu jījí, quēshǎo nàixīn.
examples.english: My dad thinks our generation is not proactive enough in doing things and lacks patience.

examples.chinese: 經過那次任務教訓後，小周做事就變得更加小心了。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò nà cì rènwu jiàoxùn hòu, Xiǎo Zhōu zuòshì jiù biàn de gèngjiā xiǎoxīn le.
examples.english: After the lesson from that mission, Xiao Zhou became even more careful in doing things.

examples.chinese: 做事不順利時別只想著逃避，得好好面對才行。
examples.pinyin: Zuòshì bù shùnlì shí bié zhǐ xiǎngzhe táobì, děi hǎohǎo miànduì cái xíng.
examples.english: When things don't go smoothly, don't just think about escaping; you must face them properly.

examples.chinese: 他很愛惜東西，所以東西都能用很久，省了不少錢。
examples.pinyin: Tā hěn àixī dōngxi, suǒyǐ dōngxi dōu néng yòng hěn jiǔ, shěng le bùshǎo qián.
examples.english: He really cherishes things, so things can all be used for a long time, and he has saved quite a bit of money.

examples.chinese: 在台北市租房子太貴了，住在郊區可以省一點兒錢。
examples.pinyin: Zài Táiběi shì zū fángzi tài guì le, zhù zài jiāoqū kěyǐ shěng yīdiǎnr qián.
examples.english: Renting a house in Taipei City is too expensive; living in the suburbs can save a little money.

examples.chinese: 小歐為了省錢，整個月都吃泡麵，最後吃壞了身體，吃藥、住院花了更多錢。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Ōu wèile shěng qián, zhěngge yuè dōu chī pàomiàn, zuìhòu chī huài le shēntǐ, chī yào, zhùyuàn huā le gèng duō qián.
examples.english: In order to save money, Xiao Ou ate instant noodles for a whole month; in the end, he ruined his health, and spent even more money on medicine and hospitalization.

examples.chinese: 在我爺爺奶奶的年代，生活比較辛苦，不少窮人為了省錢，衣服破了還是繼續穿。
examples.pinyin: Zài wǒ yéye nǎinai de niándài, shēnghuó bǐjiào xīnkǔ, bùshǎo qióngrén wèile shěng qián, yīfu pò le háishì jìxù chuān.
examples.english: In my grandparents' era, life was relatively hard; many poor people, in order to save money, continued to wear clothes even after they were torn.

examples.chinese: 我喜歡在網路商店購物，除了能省不少時間，還可以把商品送到家。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān zài wǎnglù shāngdiàn gòuwù, chúle néng shěng bùshǎo shíjiān, hái kěyǐ bǎ shāngpǐn sòng dào jiā.
examples.english: I like to go shopping at online stores; besides saving a lot of time, they can also deliver the goods to your home.

examples.chinese: 越來越多人選擇上網購物，有的是為了節省時間，有的是因為比價很方便。
examples.pinyin: Yuè lái yuè duō rén xuǎnzé shàngwǎng gòuwù, yǒude shì wèile jiéshěng shíjiān, yǒude shì yīnwèi bǐjià hěn fāngbiàn.
examples.english: More and more people choose to shop online; some do so to save time, and some because comparing prices is very convenient.

examples.chinese: 背包客為了解省交通費，經常搭別人的車到下一個地點。
examples.pinyin: Bèibāokè wèile jiéshěng jiāotōng fèi, jīngcháng dā biérén de chē dào xià yí ge dìdiǎn.
examples.english: In order to save on transportation costs, backpackers often hitch rides in other people's cars to the next place.

examples.chinese: 便利的交通，不僅縮短了南北城市的距離，也節省了人們寶貴的時間。
examples.pinyin: Biànlì de jiāotōng, bùjǐn suōduǎn le nánběi chéngshì de jùlí, yě jiéshěng le rénmen bǎoguì de shíjiān.
examples.english: Convenient transportation has not only shortened the distance between northern and southern cities, but also saved people's precious time.

examples.chinese: 以電腦系統取代傳統收停車費的方式，能幫老闆節省工作人員的費用。
examples.pinyin: Yǐ diànnǎo xìtǒng qǔdài chuántǒng shōu tíngchē fèi de fāngshì, néng bāng lǎobǎn jiéshěng gōngzuò rényuán de fèiyòng.
examples.english: Replacing the traditional method of collecting parking fees with a computer system can help the boss save on staff costs.

examples.chinese: 像食物銀行、愛心冰箱此類處理食物的做法，不但可以節省資源，還能幫助需要的人。
examples.pinyin: Xiàng shíwù yínháng, àixīn bīngxiāng cǐ lèi chǔlǐ shíwù de zuòfǎ, bùdàn kěyǐ jiéshěng zīyuán, hái néng bāngzhù xūyào de rén.
examples.english: This kind of approach to handling food, such as food banks and love refrigerators, not only can save resources but also can help people in need.

examples.chinese: 不管做任何事都應先了解情況，省得白花精神。
examples.pinyin: Bùguǎn zuò rènhé shì dōu yīng xiān liǎojiě qíngkuàng, shěngde bái huā jīngshén.
examples.english: No matter what you do, you should first understand the situation, so as to avoid wasting energy in vain.

examples.chinese: 我每個月都會清一次冷氣，這樣比較省電，風也比較涼。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měi gè yuè dōu huì qīng yī cì lěngqì, zhèyàng bǐjiào shěng diàn, fēng yě bǐjiào liáng.
examples.english: I clean the air conditioner once every month; this way it saves more electricity, and the air is cooler too.

examples.chinese: 完全按照別人的話來工作，是很省事沒錯，卻失去了讓自己進步的機會。
examples.pinyin: Wánquán ànzhào biérén de huà lái gōngzuò, shì hěn shěngshì méicuò, què shīqù le ràng zìjǐ jìnbù de jīhuì.
examples.english: Working completely according to others' words is indeed very trouble-saving, but it loses the opportunity to let yourself improve.

examples.chinese: 我住的地方距離公司很近，省了很多時間與交通費。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhù de dìfāng jùlí gōngsī hěn jìn, shěng le hěn duō shíjiān yǔ jiāotōngfèi.
examples.english: The place where I live is very close to the company, which saves a lot of time and transportation costs.

examples.chinese: 冷氣的溫度要是控制得剛好，不但對健康好，也能省點兒電費。
examples.pinyin: Lěngqì de wēndù yàoshi kòngzhì de gānghǎo, bùdàn duì jiànkāng hǎo, yě néng shěng diǎnr diànfèi.
examples.english: If the air conditioner's temperature is controlled to be just right, it is not only good for health but also saves a bit on electricity bills.

examples.chinese: 我請旅行社代訂從台北直飛美國的班機，機票較貴，但能節省不少時間。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ qǐng lǚxíngshè dài dìng cóng Táiběi zhífēi Měiguó de bānjī, jīpiào jiào guì, dàn néng jiéshěng bùshǎo shíjiān.
examples.english: I asked the travel agency to book a flight from Taipei directly to the US; the ticket is more expensive, but it can save quite a bit of time.

examples.chinese: 我的朋友會理頭髮，為了省錢我們常常去找他。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de péngyǒu huì lǐ tóufa, wèile shěng qián wǒmen chángcháng qù zhǎo tā.
examples.english: My friend can cut hair; in order to save money, we often go to him.

examples.chinese: 別看張老闆平日吃的、用的都很省，其實他是某家大型電子企業的老闆。
examples.pinyin: Bié kàn Zhāng lǎobǎn píngrì chī de, yòng de dōu hěn shěng, qíshí tā shì mǒu jiā dàxíng diànzǐ qǐyè de lǎobǎn.
examples.english: Don't be fooled by how economical Boss Zhang is in what he eats and uses every day—he's actually the boss of a large electronics company.

examples.chinese: 人們為了節省勞力，發明了許多實用的機械。
examples.pinyin: Rénmen wèile jiéshěng láolì, fāmíng le xǔduō shíyòng de jīxiè.
examples.english: In order to save labor, people invented many practical machines.

examples.chinese: 在人生地不熟的地方旅行時，如有當地人帶路，就可以節省不少時間。
examples.pinyin: Zài rénshēngdìbùshú de dìfāng lǚxíng shí, rú yǒu dāngdìrén dàilù, jiù kěyǐ jiéshěng bùshǎo shíjiān.
examples.english: When traveling in a place where you are unfamiliar with the people and surroundings, if a local leads the way, you can save quite a bit of time.

items.wordHook: One of 少(few) 目(division)s in a country is a 省(province).

examples.chinese: 我們學校的禮堂看起來空間不大，其實坐得下一千人。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xuéxiào de lǐtáng kàn qǐlái kōngjiān bú dà, qíshí zuò de xià yì qiān rén.
examples.english: Our school's auditorium looks like it doesn't have much space, but actually it can seat a thousand people.

examples.chinese: 那兩家便利商店同樣提供客人休息的座位，但是第二家的空間比第一家大多了。林媽媽總是給她的雙胞胎女兒穿同樣顏色、同樣大小的衣服。
examples.pinyin: Nà liǎng jiā biànlì shāngdiàn tóngyàng tígōng kèrén xiūxi de zuòwèi, dànshì dì èr jiā de kōngjiān bǐ dì yī jiā dà duō le. Lín māma zǒngshì gěi tā de shuāngbāotāi nǚ'ér chuān tóngyàng yánsè, tóngyàng dàxiǎo de yīfu.
examples.english: Those two convenience stores similarly provide seats for customers to rest, but the second store's space is much larger than the first's. Mrs. Lin always dresses her twin daughters in clothes of the same color and the same size.

examples.chinese: 那家動物餐廳的空間很大，可以讓客人的小動物自由自在地活動。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā dòngwù cāntīng de kōngjiān hěn dà, kěyǐ ràng kèrén de xiǎo dòngwù zìyóuzìzài de huódòng.
examples.english: That animal restaurant has a lot of space, allowing guests' small pets to move around freely and fancy-free.

examples.chinese: 那部電影沒有結局，是導演要留給觀眾想像的空間。
examples.pinyin: Nà bù diànyǐng méiyǒu jiéjú, shì dǎoyǎn yào liú gěi guānzhòng xiǎngxiàng de kōngjiān.
examples.english: That movie has no ending; it is that the director wanted to leave space for the audience's imagination.

examples.chinese: 只有圖畫，沒有文字的故事書 ，能夠留給兒童想像及思考的空間。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu túhuà, méiyǒu wénzì de gùshìshū, nénggòu liú gěi értóng xiǎngxiàng jí sīkǎo de kōngjiān.
examples.english: Storybooks with only pictures and no text can leave children room for imagination and thinking.

examples.chinese: 為了提高這座城市的文化水準，市長積極建設藝術表演中心、圖書館等公共空間。像機場、高鐵、捷運這類公共交通建設，都需要很多經費才能完成。
examples.pinyin: Wèile tígāo zhè zuò chéngshì de wénhuà shuǐzhǔn, shìzhǎng jījí jiànshè yìshù biǎoyǎn zhōngxīn, túshūguǎn děng gōnggòng kōngjiān. Xiàng jīchǎng, gāotiě, jiéyùn zhè lèi gōnggòng jiāotōng jiànshè, dōu xūyào hěn duō jīngfèi cái néng wánchéng.
examples.english: In order to raise the cultural level of this city, the mayor actively builds public spaces such as art performance centers and libraries. Public transportation construction such as airports, high-speed rail, and MRT requires a lot of funds to complete.

examples.chinese: 雖然新租的房子空間不大，環境倒挺乾淨的。
examples.pinyin: Suīrán xīn zū de fángzi kōngjiān bù dà, huánjìng dào tǐng gānjìng de.
examples.english: Although the newly rented house is not spacious, the environment is actually quite clean.

examples.chinese: 我想在床旁邊擺個書桌，不過空間不太夠，你可以幫我把床移到牆邊嗎？
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng zài chuáng pángbiān bǎi ge shūzhuō, búguò kōngjiān bú tài gòu, nǐ kěyǐ bāng wǒ bǎ chuáng yí dào qiáng biān ma?
examples.english: I want to put a desk next to the bed, but there isn't quite enough space. Could you help me move the bed to the wall?

examples.chinese: 傳說月亮上住著一隻兔子，這個神話留給孩子們許多想像空間。
examples.pinyin: Chuánshuō yuèliang shàng zhù zhe yī zhī tùzi, zhège shénhuà liú gěi háizimen xǔduō xiǎngxiàng kōngjiān.
examples.english: Legend has it that a rabbit lives on the moon; this myth leaves children a lot of room for imagination.

examples.chinese: 這棟房子空間小，位置離市區又遠，所以價值三百萬而已。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dòng fángzi kōngjiān xiǎo, wèizhì lí shìqū yòu yuǎn, suǒyǐ jiàzhí sānbǎi wàn éryǐ.
examples.english: This house has little space and is far from the city center, so it is worth only three million.

examples.chinese: 媽媽把放在院子裡的一堆空瓶子、空罐子都扔了。今天的作業是寫一篇作文，可是我的腦子空空的，一個字也寫不出來。
examples.pinyin: Māma bǎ fàng zài yuànzi lǐ de yī duī kōng píngzi, kōng guànzi dōu rēng le. Jīntiān de zuòyè shì xiě yī piān zuòwén, kěshì wǒ de nǎozi kōngkōng de, yī gè zì yě xiě bù chūlái.
examples.english: Mom threw away all the empty bottles and empty cans that were placed in the yard. Today's homework is to write a composition, but my mind is completely empty; I can't write a single word.

examples.chinese: 教授的房間堆滿了各種書籍，本來就不大的房間感覺更擠了。
examples.pinyin: Jiàoshòu de fángjiān duī mǎn le gè zhǒng shūjí, běnlái jiù bù dà de fángjiān gǎnjué gèng jǐ le.
examples.english: The professor's room is piled full of all kinds of books; the room, which wasn't big to begin with, feels even more crowded.

examples.chinese: 根據本大樓的管理規定，私人物品不可堆在公共區域。
examples.pinyin: Gēnjù běn dàlóu de guǎnlǐ guīdìng, sīrén wùpǐn bùkě duī zài gōnggòng qūyù.
examples.english: According to the management rules of this building, personal items may not be piled up in public areas.

items.wordHook: Piles of fertile dark 土(soil) are heaped together where a nesting 隹(bird) perches atop the high 堆(pile).

examples.chinese: 他是一個誠實的孩子，做錯事一定會勇敢承認的。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì yī ge chéngshí de háizi, zuò cuò shì yīdìng huì yǒnggǎn chéngrèn de.
examples.english: He is an honest child; if he does something wrong, he will definitely bravely admit it.

examples.chinese: 那位業務員不但謙虛而且誠實，你有需要的話可以請他協助。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi yèwùyuán bùdàn qiānxū érqiě chéngshí, nǐ yǒu xūyào de huà kěyǐ qǐng tā xiézhù.
examples.english: That salesman is not only modest but also honest; if you need anything, you can ask him for assistance.

items.wordHook: Combining 誠(honest) and 實(real): 誠實 means honest.

examples.chinese: 這本中文教材是網路書店出版的，你得上網才買得到。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn zhōngwén jiàocái shì wǎnglù shūdiàn chūbǎn de, nǐ děi shàngwǎng cái mǎi de dào.
examples.english: This Chinese textbook is published by an online bookstore; you have to go online to be able to buy it.

examples.chinese: 這家公司出版的小說，陪著不少讀者一塊兒成長，也帶給他們無窮的樂趣。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī chūbǎn de xiǎoshuō, péi zhe bùshǎo dúzhě yíkuàir chéngzhǎng, yě dài gěi tāmen wúqióng de lèqù.
examples.english: The novels published by this company have accompanied many readers as they grew up, and have also brought them endless joy.

items.wordHook: Stepping 出(go out) into or toward 版(printing block): 出版 means publish.

examples.chinese: 現在的手機都具有語音轉成文字的功能，用來記錄事情非常便利。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài de shǒujī dōu jùyǒu yǔyīn zhuǎn chéng wénzì de gōngnéng, yòng lái jìlù shìqíng fēicháng biànlì.
examples.english: Today's mobile phones all have the function of converting voice into text, which is very convenient for recording things.

examples.chinese: 我剛來臺灣，不知道怎麼在銀行開戶存錢，請教我怎麼申請。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gāng lái Táiwān, bù zhīdào zěnme zài yínháng kāihù cúnqián, qǐng jiào wǒ zěnme shēnqǐng.
examples.english: I just came to Taiwan and don't know how to open an account and deposit money at a bank; please teach me how to apply.

examples.chinese: 教授打算向學校申請一筆經費，進行高山地區的調查計畫。
examples.pinyin: Jiàoshòu dǎsuàn xiàng xuéxiào shēnqǐng yī bǐ jīngfèi, jìnxíng gāoshān dìqū de diàochá jìhuà.
examples.english: The professor plans to apply to the school for a sum of funding to carry out a survey project in the high mountain areas.

examples.chinese: 想申請獎學金的話，得先影印你的證件，再把影本寄給學校。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎng shēnqǐng jiǎngxuéjīn de huà, děi xiān yìngyìn nǐ de zhèngjiàn, zài bǎ yǐngběn jì gěi xuéxiào.
examples.english: If you want to apply for a scholarship, you must first photocopy your ID, and then mail the photocopy to the school.

examples.chinese: 他的獎學金申請書因少了一份資料，已被學校退回。
examples.pinyin: Tā de jiǎngxuéjīn shēnqǐngshū yīn shǎo le yī fèn zīliào, yǐ bèi xuéxiào tuìhuí.
examples.english: His scholarship application was returned by the school because it was missing one document.

examples.chinese: 申請留學的過程中，最讓人操心的可能就是寫讀書計畫了。
examples.pinyin: Shēnqǐng liúxué de guòchéng zhōng, zuì ràng rén cāoxīn de kěnéng jiù shì xiě dúshū jìhuà le.
examples.english: In the process of applying to study abroad, what worries people the most is probably writing the study plan.

examples.chinese: 這次申請獎學金，達到標準的學生總共不超過十人。

examples.english: On my birthday, my wife knitted a hat with her own hands and gave it to me, which moved me very much.

items.wordHook: 以(yǐ) + 後(behind) → what comes behind this moment: 以後(afterward; in the future).
a 弓(bow) takes a 長(long) full draw back → one 張(stretch).
怎(how) + 麼 + 樣(way) → 'what way?' → asking how about something.
a 几(table) of 朩(split wood) tips and spills a single 朵(blossom).
自(self) + 己(self) → the self, yourself: 自己 means oneself.
a 金(gold) ore and a 𢦏(blade) go to the 呈(petition) of the forge → 鐵(iron).
You gently bring warm 飠(food) to calm an animal trembling with 畏(fear) → 餵(feed).
Combining 高(tall) and 速(prompt): 高速 means high speed.
